# Stillness in the City — A Weekend Meditation Retreat

Hosted by **The Quiet Room**, an independent meditation studio in Lisbon.

## About this retreat

Stillness in the City is a two-day residential retreat for people who want to build a sustainable meditation practice without leaving their lives behind. Over the weekend you will be guided through seated meditation, mindful movement, and long stretches of silence, with teaching sessions that connect the practice to ordinary working life.

The retreat is suitable for complete beginners as well as experienced practitioners. No prior experience is required, and there is no expectation of any particular belief system.

## What the weekend includes

- Six guided meditation sessions across the two days
- Two teaching sessions on establishing a daily practice
- Mindful movement each morning
- Vegetarian lunch on both days
- A written practice guide to take home

## Schedule

The retreat runs on **Saturday 14 March 2026**, beginning at 9:30 AM. Doors open at 9:00 AM for registration and tea.

Please arrive on time — late entry is disruptive to the group once the first sitting has begun.

## Location

The Quiet Room, Príncipe Real, Lisbon, Portugal.

The studio is a ten-minute walk from Rato metro station. Exact address and door code are sent by email once your place is confirmed.

## Pricing

Tickets are €180 per person for the full weekend. A limited number of concession places are available at €120 for students and those on low income — please email us rather than booking online if you need one.

Places are limited to sixteen people so that everyone gets individual attention.

## About the teacher

The weekend is led by a teacher with fifteen years of practice in the Insight tradition and eight years of teaching experience. Teaching is secular and practice-focused.

## Cancellations

Full refunds are available up to fourteen days before the retreat. After that we can transfer your place to a future date, subject to availability.

---

The Quiet Room runs weekly drop-in sittings alongside seasonal retreats. Visit thequietroom.example for the current programme.
